text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's behavior seems odder than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Top of the morning to you, Trainer!
What a
beautiful day for training, wot
wot. ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
First up for the morn is a jolly round of
incline
dashes. What better way to build
up stamina? ♪
Haha!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us put our noses to the
grindstone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear me! My legs have given up the
ghost!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears all of those consecutive races
have
taken their toll on Gold Ship. I'd
better adjust her
race schedule a little...
